Name: AutoPet
Author: parzival212
Description:
[b]Description:[/b]
Auto Pet automatically pets all your barn and coop animals every morning before you even step outside. No more running around checking every animal — your cows, chickens, pigs, and every other animal will start each day happy and loved.

A small notification appears on screen each morning telling you how many animals were petted.

Installation Instructions:
1. Install SMAPI
2. (Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings
3. Download and unzip this mod
4. Place the AutoPet folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
5. Launch the game through SMAPI

Main Features:
- Automatically pets all barn and coop animals at the start of each day
- Works across all buildings including mod-added ones
- Shows a ♥ HUD notification with how many animals were petted
- Multiplayer safe — only runs for the main player
- Toggle on/off and notification via GMCM config menu

Requirements:
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended
